brief:
A group of Palestinian workers employed by the Israeli army came under attack by masked men near Ramallah, Middle East Eye reported. Details of the assault, including the number of workers targeted, their injuries, and the circumstances of the incident, were not immediately disclosed.

The attack raises questions about the security of Palestinians working for Israeli military contractors in occupied territories, where tensions remain high between Israeli forces and Palestinian communities.
dek: Masked men beat Palestinian workers hired by Israeli army A group of Palestinian workers hired by the Israeli army were attacked by masked men near Ramallah.
title: Masked assailants attack Palestinian workers for Israeli army near Ramallah
